newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley business units Q1 results rise.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley business units Q1 results rise.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc on Thursday reported that its two businesses, securities and asset management, both posted strong revenues for the first quarter ended February 28.

The company said within its securities business, investment banking revenues were $442 million, or 11 percent higher than the 1996 first quarter. It attributed the growth to continued strong activity in mergers and acquisitions and underwriting transactions, particularly in investment grade debt.
Sales and trading revenues were $1,018 million for the first quarter, up 9 percent over the year-ago quarter, the company said.

Asset management revenues for the quarter were $278 million, a 128 percent increase from the 1996 first quarter. The company said the results reflect growth in assets under management and administration and the first full quarter of revenues from Van Kampen American Capital Inc, which was acquired in October.
